name: sparki-video-editor
description: AI video editor for creators. Transform raw footage into polished vlogs, talking-head videos, or social media content (TikTok/Shorts/Reels) via natural-language prompts, style presets, or reference-style cloning. Uses a bundled web runner or sparki-cli with the cloud-hosted Sparki API.

interface.shortDescription: Edit videos with Sparki directly from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Turn local footage into polished vlogs, highlight reels, and social clips through natural-language editing with cloud rendering.
defaultPrompt: Edit this video into a polished vertical highlight reel.
